profiles.description: Repository instructions, schemas, and deterministic checks only. No operating-system network boundary is asserted.
limitations: AGENTS.md and Skills are behavioral controls, not a network sandbox.
URL registration validation does not verify DNS answers, redirects, or the actual connection destination.
The repository cannot disable arbitrary shell sockets on a managed platform by itself.
profiles.owner_action: Configure and verify a platform or container profile that enforces every required production control.

profiles.description: Default GitHub-hosted runner behavior before an isolated fetch service and network-restricted research container are configured.
limitations: A default hosted runner permits general network access from job processes.
Repository workflow text alone cannot prove per-tool socket isolation.
profiles.owner_action: Run research shell steps in a network-disabled container and route search/fetch and Git publication through separately authenticated services.
